'''Angor Farn''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] hired by [[Sleeft Docking Bay Maintenance]] to ship a load of [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He picked up a load of parts Sleeft had stolen from the [[Notsub Shipping Company]] by mistake, and led agents from both Sleeft and Notsub on a chase through [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="B" />
